JPG to SVG converter

Give a JPG a new shape

A JPG is a raster image with a fixed pixel grid. ImageToVector traces color regions into SVG shapes that can be resized. Upload a JPG and adjust how much color and detail the trace keeps.

JPG compression can add noise around edges. Flat artwork tends to produce simpler vectors; photographs become stylized, shape-based art. Try a lower detail setting when a compressed JPG looks noisy.

Open the free SVG tool ↗

How to turn JPG into SVG

Select the JPG, choose a color palette, then pick clean, balanced, or fine detail. Generate the SVG and inspect the result before downloading. Conversion runs on your device in this browser demo.

Can a photo be converted?

Yes. A photo can be represented as layered color shapes, but the result is an artistic approximation. More colors and detail can preserve more nuance while creating a more complex file.

Will the SVG stay sharp when resized?

SVG uses paths and shapes, so it can scale without the visible pixelation of a small JPG. The trace still reflects the source image and chosen settings.
